summary: ChatProgress: what the agent shows between the question and the answer. ONE component with a form axis — thinking, activity, steps, measured — rather than TODO's three items (Progress Long Operations, Progress Stream, Progress Sectioned List). The sheet's own Not built row asked for that and named the reason: the receipt, the motion and the collapse are shared, and three siblings would drift apart on exactly those. `form` is a DISCRIMINATED union, so a step list with no steps and a bar with no value are compile errors rather than empty boxes — an empty box is what reads as the agent having stopped. Terminal states are the same component: `isComplete` folds whatever form was in play to the receipt row (which requires its own line AND a name for the control that re-expands it), and `errorText` replaces the form with the failure line while leaving the log above it — the log is history, not chrome. One disclosure mechanism serves both summary lines: a running step list's group header and a finished run's receipt are the same Base UI Collapsible with different content. Two things are reused rather than redrawn: the measured form IS the Progress primitive at size sm (a hand-rolled track has no role="progressbar", no aria-valuenow, and no reason to reach for --ui-bg-accent-legible — the exact SC 1.4.11 failure that role exists to prevent), and Retry is Button ghost·sm, matching Chat Message. The spinner is CSS: griddy has no spinner glyph, check:icons refuses a private SVG, and a full sunken ring under a quarter accent-legible arc is what the sheet draws. Guarded `motion-safe:` rather than `motion-reduce:` so the reduced-motion default is "does not move". The sheet's shimmer sweep across the thinking label is deliberately NOT built — no motion token describes it and a literal is what check:motion refuses; recorded, along with the observation that it is the same missing decision as TODO's skeleton-animation item. Contract: --ui-intent-success-fg on --ui-bg-base joins NONTEXT_CONTRAST_PAIRS — the receiver block has no container, so the one ground every other success glyph is measured against is the one this component never draws on. Geometry spec covers the activity pill's asymmetric 8/12 inset and the step list's single 24px indent.
